_note: Edit this file, then re-run scripts/build_ewp_workbook.py. Delivery defaults, EWP groupings, owners, reviewers, decision overrides and new RFIs are all driven from here.
tender_role: MinRes is the Australian Contractor bidding to the Owner (Rio Tinto) under the EPC ITT pack. The ITT calls the Owner 'Company'.
estimate_class: Class 5 (Assumption: no drawings, MTO or priced schedule in the ITT pack)

key_risk_text.Price: Quantities not stated in the ITT pack; remeasure-rate exposure (RFI-004, RFI-013).
key_risk_text.Exclude: Boundary and interface risk with Owner or other-contractor scope.
key_risk_text.Price as Provisional Sum: Provisional Sum treatment and value basis not confirmed.
key_risk_text.Clarify: Scope undecided until the linked RFI is answered.

WIN-1600-04.reason: ITT shows Provisional, but the recharge model to the IPP Contractor is still to be determined, so MinRes cannot yet decide the pricing basis.

new_rfis.question: Confirm how concrete supplied to the IPP Contractor is to be recharged and priced (rate, basis, provisional or remeasure).
new_rfis.impact: Decides whether WIN-1600-04 is priced as a Provisional Sum, an option or excluded (currently Clarify).

new_rfis.topic: Treatment of camp and fleet options in the Contract Price
new_rfis.question: Confirm whether the camp (Options A and B) and construction fleet (Options 1 and 2) are priced as separate options, Provisional Sums or in the base price.
new_rfis.impact: Decides base price versus option for four FLOCs (currently Price as Option or Alternative). Relates to RFI-002.

new_rfis.topic: Tender closing date and RFI cut-off
new_rfis.question: Confirm whether the tender closing date of 07/10/2026 4:00pm AWST has been extended.
new_rfis.impact: Determines whether any scope decision or RFI can still be actioned before submission.

ewps.title: Site clearing, topsoil, borrow and landfill earthworks
ewps.desc: Clearing, grubbing, topsoil, borrow pits, waste management area earthworks and on-Site landfill.

ewps.title: Mine Access Road, intersections, drainage and borefield tracks
ewps.desc: 182 km sealed Mine Access Road earthworks and pavement, highway intersections, rest areas, drainage structures, existing access tracks and borefield access tracks. Concrete is in EWP-CON-01.

ewps.title: Bulk earthworks and pads by area
ewps.desc: Bulk earthworks, roads and pads for Village access, MSA, MPP enabling works, IPP areas, aerodrome and explosives area.

ewps.title: Ore stockpiles, ponds and surface water management
ewps.desc: Stockpile bases, clean water bunds, detention and stormwater ponds, dewatering pond (HDPE-lined items per specification).

ewps.title: TSF Stage 0 earthworks, liner and drainage
ewps.desc: TSF Stage 0 impoundment earthworks, HDPE liner and CQA, drainage, tailings corridors and material supply. Liner is a specialist subcontract.

ewps.title: Permanent Village external works
ewps.desc: Sports court, yarning circle, bus and LME parking and charging bays, walking track.

ewps.title: Mine pre-strip, waste rock landform and haul roads
ewps.desc: Mine planning and production control, drill and blast, overburden mining, haul roads, waste rock landform, exclusion zones and mine drainage.

ewps.title: Concrete and reinforcement, all areas
ewps.desc: Concrete for Mine Access Road, Village, MSA, MPP, aerodrome, TSF and explosives area. Reinforcement is supply-only.

ewps.title: Concrete supply to the IPP Contractor (recharge)
ewps.desc: Concrete supplied to the IPP Contractor on a recharge basis. Pricing basis is a Clarify item (BID-RFI-01).

ewps.title: Permanent Village buildings
ewps.desc: Accommodation modules, administration, messes, laundries, recreation and ablution facilities, and modular building structural works. Modular accommodation is supply-only.

ewps.title: Mine Services Area buildings
ewps.desc: HME and LME workshops, warehouse, fuel storage, change house, administration, data centre and laboratory buildings.

ewps.title: Aerodrome, explosives and tower structures
ewps.desc: Aerodrome terminal, ablutions and shade structures; explosives storage buildings; 40 m and 80 m communications towers.

ewps.title: Facility mechanical, HVAC and water plants
ewps.desc: Village water and wastewater plants, HVAC and E&I areas, MSA mechanical, weighbridge and weed and seed facility, explosives area mechanical and E&I, solids waste facility.

ewps.title: Site-wide piping and buried utilities
ewps.desc: Dewatering, managed aquifer recharge, raw, potable and fire water, sewer, fuel and air piping, and buried utilities for each area.

ewps.title: Electrical and instrumentation
ewps.desc: Village LV distribution and communications network, MSA E&I, aerodrome lighting and aids, site-wide power reticulation.

ewps.title: Data centres and fleet management integration
ewps.desc: Data centres DC1 and DC2 (IS&T infrastructure) and fleet management system integration.

ewps.title: Project management, engineering, survey and QA/QC
ewps.desc: Project management, construction engineering, survey, geotechnical and QA/QC (AR-01, AR-09).

ewps.title: Mobilisation, camps, accommodation and demobilisation
ewps.desc: Mobilisation, travel, Site establishment, existing and fly camps, Company camp charge-back, flights and demobilisation. Includes camp Options A and B (AR-02, AR-03, AR-04, AR-15).

ewps.title: Temporary works, laydown, water and communications
ewps.desc: Laydown areas, temporary construction facilities, construction water, temporary communications and other temporary works (AR-05, AR-06).

ewps.title: Plant and equipment fleet
ewps.desc: Pre-strip HME and construction fleet, including fleet Options 1 and 2 (AR-08).

ewps.title: Transport, logistics and Company Supplied Items
ewps.desc: Port Hedland to Site transport, materials management, and receipt and custody of Company Supplied Items (AR-11, AR-13).

ewps.title: Site management, HSESC, interface and SIMOPS
ewps.desc: Site management, security, signage, lighting, interface management, SIMOPS, and HSESC, environmental, community and emergency response (AR-10, AR-14).

ewps.title: Pre-commissioning and commissioning support
ewps.desc: Pre-commissioning, commissioning support and handover (AR-12). Duration is open (RFI-018).

ewps.title: Shared concrete supply and SP2 general requirements
ewps.desc: Shared batch plant, concrete supply, reinforcement and cast-in items, and common SP2 structural requirements (AR-07).

ewps.title: Contract, securities, insurance and commercial administration
ewps.desc: Terms and conditions, securities, insurance, finance and contract administration (AR-16).
